ages.name: Wood Age
ages.unlocks: Wood equipment, leather armor, beds, fishing rods, campfires, composters, bundles, basic storage, boats, wool building pieces and cushions. Stone equipment and furnaces remain locked.

quests.d: Obtain 8 logs.
Craft and place a Crafting Table.
Craft a Wooden Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, Hoe and Sword.
Gather 8 sticks, 4 saplings and 8 wheat seeds.
Craft and place a Chest.
Place 24 wooden building blocks and a wooden Door.
Plant 4 saplings.
Mine 4 Coal Ore with a Wooden Pickaxe.
Craft and place a Campfire.
Cook 4 food items on a Campfire.
Craft a Bed and sleep in it.
Defeat 3 hostile mobs with wooden weapons.
Till 8 Farmland blocks beside natural water.
Plant 8 wheat seeds.
Craft and place a Composter; collect its first Bone Meal.
Successfully use Bone Meal on a crop.
Harvest 12 mature Wheat crops.
Craft 4 Bread.
Plant 4 Sugar Cane.
Place 12 Fences and a Fence Gate.
Breed a pair of Cows.
Breed a pair of Sheep.
Breed a pair of Chickens.
Craft a Fishing Rod.
Catch a fish with the rod.
Catch 12 items while fishing.
Craft Wool Slabs, make a Cushion and sit on it.
After the earlier quests, mine 24 Stone with wooden equipment; unlock Stone Age.

ages.name: Stone Age
ages.unlocks: Stone equipment, furnaces and smokers. Copper prospecting opens at the final quest chain; copper equipment waits for Copper Age. Stonecutters wait for Iron Age.

quests.d: Craft a Stone Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, Hoe and Sword.
Craft and place a Furnace.
Smelt 8 logs into Charcoal.
Craft and place 16 Torches.
Smelt 8 Sand into Glass.
Mine 128 Stone-family blocks.
Craft Stone Bricks and stone Stairs or Slabs.
Place 64 stone building blocks.
Gather Clay and smelt 16 Bricks.
Craft and plant a Flower Pot.
Craft and place a Smoker.
Cook 12 food items using the Smoker.
Plant a second conventional crop species.
Harvest 32 mature crops across at least two species.
Craft 3 Hay Bales.
Craft Straw Beds and sleep in one away from your regular bed.
Feed baby farm animals 5 times to accelerate growth.
Craft and equip Leather Boots.
Craft and use a Barrel for food storage.
Craft a Bundle and store 6 different item types in it.
Craft a Boat and travel 500 blocks in it.
Craft a Chest Boat and transport stored supplies.
Plant and harvest either Pumpkins or Melons.
Catch and smoke 4 Cod or Salmon.
When this quest opens, mine 8 Copper Ore; copper ore products become available.
Smelt 24 Copper Ingots; completing the chapter unlocks Copper Age.

ages.name: Copper Age
ages.goal: Work metal and investigate the land
ages.unlocks: Copper tools, weapons, armor and matching mount armor; copper storage, the Brush, Spyglass and copper building family. Iron equipment, buckets, shears and iron workstations remain locked.

quests.d: Craft a Copper Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel and Hoe.
Craft and equip a full set of Copper Armor.
Craft a Copper Spear.
Defeat 5 hostile mobs using a Copper Spear.
Smelt a further 32 Copper Ingots for construction.
Craft and place Cut Copper Stairs and Slabs.
Craft and place a Copper Door.
Craft and place a Lightning Rod.
Craft and place a Copper Chest.
Craft a Shelf and fill its three slots.
Craft and place a Copper Torch.
Find an Amethyst Geode.
Harvest 4 Amethyst Shards from fully grown clusters.
Craft a Spyglass and use it to look at a mob.
Craft a Brush.
Brush 4 suspicious blocks successfully.
Recover a Pottery Sherd through brushing.
Brush an Armadillo to collect Scutes.
Tame a Wolf.
Craft and equip Wolf Armor.
Repair damaged Wolf Armor with Scutes.
Mine and collect Granite, Diorite, Andesite and Tuff.
When this quest opens, mine 12 Iron Ore; iron ore products become available.
Smelt 24 Iron Ingots; completing the chapter unlocks Iron Age.

ages.name: Iron Age
ages.unlocks: Iron and gold equipment, chainmail, shields, every bucket variant, shears, Flint and Steel, crossbows, saddles, Stonecutters, Anvils, Blast Furnaces and basic Redstone machinery. Gold prospecting opens within this Age.

quests.d: Craft an Iron Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel and Hoe.
Craft an Iron Sword or Spear and defeat 8 hostile mobs.
Craft and equip a full set of Iron Armor.
Craft a Shield and block a hostile projectile.
Craft a Bucket; collect and place water.
Create a water source that hydrates your planted Farmland.
Collect lava in a Bucket.
Build a working Cobblestone generator and mine 32 blocks from it.
Craft Shears and shear 3 Sheep.
Milk a Cow and collect Eggs.
Craft a Stonecutter and cut three different building variants.
Craft a Blast Furnace and smelt 16 raw metal items.
Craft and place an Anvil.
Repair damaged iron equipment using an Anvil.
Craft a Name Tag, rename it and use it on an animal.
When this quest opens, mine Gold Ore and smelt 8 Gold Ingots.
Craft a Golden Dandelion and use it to stop a baby animal from aging.
Breed a pair of Bees.
Safely collect Honeycomb with Shears and Campfire smoke.
Safely collect Honey using a Glass Bottle.
Craft and place a Beehive.
Wax a Copper block and remove its wax with an Axe.
Carve a Pumpkin and summon a Copper Golem.
Have your Copper Golem sort three different item types.
Mine Redstone Ore and craft Redstone Torches and a Repeater.
Craft a Piston and use it to move a block.
Move 16 items between containers using a Hopper.
Activate a Dispenser to fire a projectile or place water.
Build a repeating redstone circuit that activates a copper bulb 5 times.
Power a Shelf and use its hotbar-swapping function.
Use a Crafter to produce an item automatically.
Complete 3 Villager trades.
Trade with three different Villager professions.
Advance a Villager to Journeyman through your trades.
Craft a Map and enlarge it using a Cartography Table.
Craft a Lodestone and bind a Compass to it.
Craft a Saddle, tame a Horse and ride 500 blocks.
Build a rail route using Powered Rails and ride a Minecart along it.
Craft a Bow and Crossbow; hit a hostile mob with each.
Mine Lapis Ore and collect 16 Lapis Lazuli.
Pack a Map, Compass, Water Bucket, Shield, 4 Straw Beds, 16 Bread and 64 blocks; unlock Exploration Age.

ages.name: Exploration Age
ages.unlocks: Expedition chapter using Iron-Age equipment. Wind Charges are allowed after the Breeze quest; Diamond acquisition opens only at the final prospecting quest. Enchanting, Diamond gear and Nether travel stay locked.

quests.d: Discover an Abandoned Camp.
Loot a naturally generated Camp Chest or Barrel.
Obtain a structure Explorer Map from Camp loot.
Reach a structure shown on an Explorer Map.
Enter a Dappled Forest.
Grow a Poplar Sapling and craft with its wood.
Collect Red, Orange and Yellow Poplar Leaves using Shears.
Gather Shelf Mushrooms and use them to prepare Mushroom Stew.
Grow a Shelf Mushroom and spread a Red Shrub with Bone Meal.
Place a Campfire, Chest, Straw Bed and Cushion together at an expedition stop.
Follow a Sulfur Spring down into a Sulfur Cave.
Collect Sulfur and Cinnabar and craft their building variants.
Have a Sulfur Cube absorb a wooden block.
Remove a Cube's block with Shears and replace it with a metal block.
Collect a Sulfur Cube in a Bucket.
Build a working Geyser using Potent Sulfur, water and magma or lava.
Explore a Mineshaft and open a generated Chest Minecart.
Enter a Desert Pyramid and brush a suspicious block.
Recover four Pottery Sherds and craft a decorated pot from them.
Explore a Shipwreck and recover a Buried Treasure Map.
Follow the map and recover a Heart of the Sea.
Brush suspicious blocks in a Warm Ocean Ruin.
Tame and saddle a Nautilus.
Travel 500 blocks underwater while riding your Nautilus.
Defeat a Zombie Horse's rider and claim the mount.
Defeat the riders of a Camel Husk and ride the surviving mount.
Locate and enter a Trial Chamber.
Participate in completing 3 ordinary Trial Spawner encounters.
Defeat a Breeze and collect a Breeze Rod.
Craft Wind Charges and use one to launch yourself upward.
Obtain a Trial Key and open an ordinary Vault.
Encounter a Creaking in a Pale Garden at night.
Collect Resin generated by the encounter, then destroy the linked Creaking Heart.
When this quest opens, mine 5 Diamond Ore; completing the chapter unlocks Diamond Age.

ages.name: Diamond Age
ages.unlocks: Diamond equipment and mount armor, Tridents, Enchanting Tables and Smithing Tables. Ender Chests become usable here but still need Nether materials to craft. Nether entry opens only at the final portal milestone.

quests.d: Craft a Diamond Pickaxe.
Craft a Diamond Axe, Shovel and Hoe.
Craft a Diamond Sword or Spear.
Craft and equip a full set of Diamond Armor.
Mine 14 Obsidian.
Craft and place an Enchanting Table.
Supply the table with 15 correctly positioned Bookshelves.
Reach experience level 30.
Perform a level-30 Enchanting Table enchantment.
Enchant a tool, a weapon and an armor piece.
Apply Fortune to a Pickaxe and use it to mine ore.
Combine compatible enchanted equipment in an Anvil.
Apply an Enchanted Book to equipment using an Anvil.
Use a Grindstone to remove a non-curse enchantment.
Obtain an Enchanted Book through Villager trading.
Advance a Villager to Master and complete a trade at that level.
Apply an Armor Trim at a Smithing Table.
Obtain Silk Touch and use it to harvest an otherwise fragile block intact.
Relocate an occupied Bee Nest using Silk Touch.
Craft Concrete Stairs and Slabs and use both in a build.
Enter the Deep Dark and avoid triggering a Sculk Sensor while sneaking.
Locate an Ancient City and open a generated chest.
Obtain 8 Echo Shards and craft a Recovery Compass.
Obtain a Sniffer Egg through Ocean Archaeology and hatch it.
Let your Sniffer uncover seeds; grow Torchflowers and Pitcher Plants.
Breed Turtles and protect eggs until they hatch.
Collect Scutes as baby Turtles grow and craft a Turtle Shell.
Obtain a Trident and hit a hostile mob with a thrown attack.
Free an Allay and have it return an item to you.
Construct and ignite a Nether Portal; completing the chapter unlocks Nether travel and Nether Age.

ages.name: Nether Age
ages.unlocks: Nether travel and materials, brewing and potion use, quartz machinery, Ender Chests by recipe access, and Happy Ghast flight. Netherite smithing opens after its research chain. End Eyes and portal entry open at the final chain.

quests.d: Enter the Nether.
Place protective blocks around your arrival point and return through your portal.
Gather Netherrack, Blackstone, Quartz and Glowstone.
Grow and harvest both Crimson and Warped Huge Fungi.
Equip Gold Armor before approaching Piglins.
Complete 8 Piglin barters.
Receive four different barter outputs.
Enter a Bastion Remnant and loot a generated chest.
Recover a Netherite Upgrade Template.
Locate and enter a Nether Fortress.
Defeat 6 Blazes.
Obtain 8 Blaze Rods from Blazes.
Collect Soul Sand and Nether Wart; plant a Wart patch.
Harvest 16 mature Nether Wart.
Craft and place a Brewing Stand.
Brew an Awkward Potion.
Brew and drink a Potion of Fire Resistance.
Brew a Potion of Strength.
Brew a Potion of Healing.
Extend a potion's duration using Redstone.
Strengthen a compatible potion using Glowstone.
Brew a Splash Potion.
Weaken and cure a Zombie Villager.
Brew Night Vision and Water Breathing potions.
Collect a Phantom Membrane and brew Slow Falling.
Craft and operate a Copper Bulb.
Use an Observer to trigger a Piston.
Use a Comparator to read a container's contents.
Automatically harvest and collect Sugar Cane or Bamboo.
Craft two Ender Chests and retrieve an item placed in the other.
Saddle a Strider and steer it across 250 blocks of lava.
Visit all five Nether biomes.
Craft, charge and set your spawn at a Respawn Anchor in the Nether.
Link two portal sites and travel at least 1,000 Overworld blocks using the Nether.
Obtain a Dried Ghast and rehydrate it into a Ghastling.
Raise the Ghastling, craft a Harness and fly your Happy Ghast.
When this quest opens, mine 4 Ancient Debris.
Smelt the debris and craft a Netherite Ingot.
Duplicate an Upgrade Template; this unlocks Netherite smithing.
Upgrade a Diamond Pickaxe into a Netherite Pickaxe.
Obtain 16 Ender Pearls; completing this unlocks Eye crafting and frame insertion.
Craft 16 Eyes of Ender.
Use Eyes to locate and enter a Stronghold.
Find and activate an End Portal, or reach one already activated; completing the chapter unlocks End entry.

ages.name: End Age
ages.unlocks: End travel and resources. Shulker Boxes unlock after collecting shells; Elytra use unlocks after recovering the wings. The Mace and proposed Wither/Beacon progression remain locked until Post-End.

quests.d: Enter the End and reach its central island.
Mine 32 End Stone.
Contribute to destroying the Dragon's healing crystals.
Deal damage to the Ender Dragon.
Participate in defeating the Dragon.
Collect Dragon's Breath during a Dragon encounter.
Recover or interact with a placed Dragon Egg trophy; shared encounter credit also counts.
Travel through an End Gateway.
Collect Chorus Fruit and a Chorus Flower.
Plant Chorus and harvest fruit from your grown plant.
Smelt Popped Chorus Fruit and craft Purpur and End Rods.
Discover an End City.
Defeat 6 Shulkers.
Collect 2 Shulker Shells; this unlocks Shulker Box crafting and use.
Craft a Shulker Box and transport items inside it.
Dye a Shulker Box.
Reach an End Ship.
Recover Elytra; this unlocks equipping and gliding.
Glide 1,000 blocks with Elytra.
Craft Rockets and use 8 to boost while gliding.
Return to the Overworld with your End discoveries.
Brew a Lingering Potion using Dragon's Breath and craft Tipped Arrows.
Craft and place 4 End Crystals to respawn the Dragon.
Defeat the respawned Dragon; completing the chapter unlocks Post-End Age.

ages.name: Post-End Age
ages.unlocks: Mace crafting and use; proposed Wither summoning and Beacon gates. All ordinary equipment is now available. Every listed quest is required for full completion.

quests.d: Obtain 3 Wither Skeleton Skulls.
Summon the Wither.
Participate in defeating the Wither.
Craft and activate a Beacon.
Build a four-layer pyramid and activate a level-II Beacon power.
Upgrade and equip full Netherite Armor.
Upgrade the remaining tools and a Sword or Spear to Netherite.
Upgrade Diamond Horse Armor to Netherite Horse Armor.
Obtain an Ominous Bottle and trigger an Ominous Trial.
Complete Ominous Trials and open an Ominous Vault.
Obtain a Heavy Core.
Craft a Mace and land a smash attack.
Combine a Wind Charge jump with a Mace smash attack.
Participate in winning a Raid.
Obtain and activate a Totem of Undying.
Defeat the three Elder Guardians of an Ocean Monument, with team credit.
Collect wet Sponges, dry them and use them to drain water.
Craft and fully activate a Conduit.
Catch an Axolotl in a Bucket and assist it in winning a fight.
Breed Frogs and collect a Tadpole in a Bucket.
Raise Tadpoles into all three Frog variants.
Produce all three Froglight colors.
Duplicate an Allay using an Amethyst Shard while music plays.
Have an Allay deliver collected items to a Note Block.
Have a Sulfur Cube absorb TNT and detonate it in an excavating area.
Use Honey Blocks or Slime Blocks in a working Piston mechanism.
Build a device activated by a Sculk Sensor.
Use a Calibrated Sculk Sensor to respond to a selected vibration frequency.
Craft a Creaking Heart and activate it between correctly aligned Pale Oak Logs.
Connect material storage, automatic smelting and a Crafter; produce 64 final items through the chain.
Brew Regeneration, Swiftness, Invisibility, Leaping, Poison, Weakness, Slowness, Harming and Turtle Master potions.
Brew Infestation, Oozing, Weaving and Wind Charging potions.
Grow and harvest every crop in the 24-entry cultivation checklist below.
Complete the vanilla advancement for eating every required food.
Complete vanilla's Two by Two breeding criteria, including producing a Mule.
Tame a Cat, Parrot, Donkey and Llama; breed a Mule.
Ride a Camel and a Zombie Nautilus; obtain a Goat Horn.
Fish up all four fish species, three junk types and three treasure types.
Trade with every trading Villager profession and the Wandering Trader.
Use Bricks, Terracotta, Glazed Terracotta, Concrete, Glass and multiple wood and stone families in builds.
Decorate a Banner with a Loom; display it, a Painting and an Armor Stand.
Craft all 16 dyes and use them across your builds.
Apply 8 different Armor Trim patterns.
Obtain 12 different Pottery Sherds.
Obtain and play 8 different Music Discs.
Reach the destinations of 8 different Explorer Map types.
Complete the vanilla biome exploration advancement.
Travel 1,000 blocks each by rail, boat and mount; fly 5,000 blocks with Elytra.
Complete every preceding quest in all nine Ages.
